reply_text:
I saved the draft mail to Hollis Mbeki (hmbeki@pemberline.com) and replied to Anselm in your DM. The draft hasn't been sent; it stays in drafts until someone sends it.

- **Why it was allowed:** a per-seat rate is a finance figure, and Anselm is the CFO, one of the two people who can approve sharing one. The address is inside pemberline.com, so Ruth didn't need to approve it.
- **What the draft says:** the subject is "Thornbury Cloth Co. – proposed 2027 per-seat rate". It gives the rate as $2,101 a seat, says the figure came from Marcus Lindqvist and that Anselm approved sharing it, and asks Hollis to keep it within the account team and finance.
- **Not checked:** I used the figure exactly as Anselm gave it. I didn't find a separate record of the rate to compare it against; the notes search found nothing on it and only ran in keyword mode.
